source.scope: Additional Win32 BOOL/APC comparison and finite timed waits; two enormous pending waits are released by own helper thread after2ms, never left blocked.

finding: Both measured NtWaitForSingleObject and WaitForSingleObjectEx truncate the exercised alertable value to BOOLEAN low byte;0x100 is false and0x101 true. Queued user APC wins over signaled event. Current guest Win32 helper uses full bool and tests object first.
qualification: One ARM64 kernel; timing samples show substantial scheduling delay and do not establish nanosecond-level latency equivalence.
